passes.name: OnnxConversion
passes.description: Convert a PyTorch model to ONNX format.

use_external_data_format.description: Store weights in external files; required for models >2GB.

dynamic_axes.description: Map of axis names to dynamic dimensions, e.g. {'input': {0: 'batch'}}.

gotchas: Models >2GB require use_external_data_format=True.
Dynamic shapes must be declared via dynamic_axes; otherwise batch/sequence dims are fixed.

passes.name: OnnxQuantization
passes.description: Quantize an ONNX model to int8 using static or dynamic calibration.

quant_format.description: QOperator bakes quantize into ops; QDQ inserts Quantize/Dequantize nodes and is more portable.

per_channel.description: Per-channel weights improve accuracy but are not supported on all accelerators.

reduce_range.description: Use 7-bit range for compatibility with older Intel AVX2.

calibration_data_dir.description: Path to representative calibration data. Required for static quantization.

calibration_sampling_size.description: Number of samples to use for calibration.

gotchas: Static quantization requires representative calibration data.
QDQ format is slower on CPU but required for many NPUs.
Per-channel quantization improves CNN accuracy but may not be supported on mobile NPUs.

passes.name: OnnxDynamicQuantization
passes.description: Dynamic int8 quantization; no calibration data required.
gotchas: No calibration data required, but throughput can be lower than static quantization.
Dynamic quantization is best for LSTM/Transformer decoders.

passes.name: OnnxStaticQuantization
passes.description: Static int8 quantization with representative calibration data.
gotchas: Calibration data must match inference distribution or accuracy drops.
Start with 100-300 samples; more does not always help.

passes.name: NVModelOptQuantization
passes.description: NVIDIA TensorRT Model Optimizer quantization (AWQ/RTN).

algorithm.description: AWQ (Activation-aware Weight Quantization) preserves accuracy for LLMs; RTN is faster but lower quality.

gotchas: Requires nvidia-modelopt package.
AWQ is calibration-light; RTN is calibration-free.
Best for NVIDIA RTX/TensorRT targets.

passes.name: QNNQuantization
passes.description: Quantize for Qualcomm QNN execution provider.

per_channel.description: Qualcomm NPUs require per-channel symmetric quantization for best accuracy.

gotchas: Qualcomm NPU prefers symmetric per-channel quantization.
Some ops (e.g. LayerNorm) may not be supported on QNN; check whitelist.

passes.name: VitisAIQuantization
passes.description: Xilinx Vitis AI quantization with power-of-2 scales.
gotchas: Power-of-2 scale constraint may reduce accuracy; calibrate carefully.

passes.name: IncQuantization
passes.description: Intel Neural Compressor unified quantization.
gotchas: Intel NC works best with PyTorch source models.
NF4 requires Intel NC >= 3.0.

passes.name: OnnxModelOptimizer
passes.description: General ONNX graph optimization (constant folding, dead code elimination).

graph_optimization_level.description: Level of ONNX Runtime graph optimization.

optimize_model_only.description: Only optimize the ONNX model, do not quantize.

gotchas: Run before quantization for cleaner quantized graph.

passes.name: OrtTransformersOptimization
passes.description: ONNX Runtime transformer-specific fusion and optimization.
gotchas: Requires correct num_heads and hidden_size for transformer models.
Set min/max sequence lengths for batch inference.

passes.name: OnnxFloatToFloat16
passes.description: Cast float32 tensors to float16.

keep_io_types.description: Keep inputs/outputs in float32 for numerical stability.

gotchas: Can cause accuracy loss in models not trained for FP16.
Keep I/O types float32 to avoid downstream precision issues.

passes.name: IncPruning
passes.description: Intel Neural Compressor magnitude/structured pruning.

target_sparsity.description: Target fraction of weights to zero out.

gotchas: Sparsity must be matched to a sparse-aware execution provider for speedup.
High sparsity (>70%) usually requires fine-tuning to recover accuracy.

passes.name: LoRA
passes.description: Low-Rank Adaptation fine-tuning.

lora_rank.description: LoRA rank; higher captures more signal but uses more memory.

gotchas: Base model stays frozen; only low-rank adapters train.
Target modules vary by model architecture (q_proj/v_proj for Llama, query/key/value for BERT).

passes.name: QLoRA
passes.description: Quantized LoRA fine-tuning (4-bit base model + LoRA adapters).
gotchas: Requires bitsandbytes and a CUDA GPU.
4-bit base + LoRA is memory-efficient but merging adapters back is non-trivial.

passes.name: IncDistillation
passes.description: Knowledge distillation using Intel Neural Compressor.
gotchas: Calibration can be slow; start with 1-2 epochs to validate pipeline.
Teacher and student must output compatible logits.

passes.name: OrtPerfTuning
passes.description: ONNX Runtime performance tuning for execution provider settings.
gotchas: Profiling can be expensive; use a small sample set.

passes.name: IncDynamicQuantization
passes.description: Intel Neural Compressor dynamic quantization.
gotchas: No calibration data required; accuracy may lag static quantization.

passes.name: IncStaticQuantization
passes.description: Intel Neural Compressor static quantization.
gotchas: Calibration data must be representative of inference distribution.

passes.name: OnnxOpVersionConversion

passes.name: QairtPipeline

qnn_sdk_root.description: Path to Qualcomm QNN SDK root directory.

gotchas: Replaces the deprecated QairtPreparation + QairtGenAIBuilder multi-step workflow.

YAML recipe format is defined by Qualcomm QAIRT documentation.

passes.name: KQuant
passes.description: ggml-style weight-only K-quant quantization (asymmetric/symmetric, 2/4/8-bit) for PyTorch models.
gotchas: Produces ggml-compatible quantized weights.
2-bit quantization may cause significant accuracy loss on smaller models.
K-quant types (q4_k, q6_k) use non-uniform bit allocation for better accuracy.

passes.name: OnnxKquantQuantization
passes.description: K-quant quantization for ONNX models using ggml-style block quantization.
gotchas: ONNX variant of KQuant for models already in ONNX format.
K-quant types use non-uniform bit allocation across weight blocks.
DirectML supports K-quant execution on Windows.

passes.name: QuantizeEmbeddingInt8
passes.description: Graph surgery for INT8 embedding quantization. Reduces embedding table memory by quantizing to int8.
gotchas: Reduces embedding table size by 2-4x with minimal accuracy impact.
Pairs well with ShareEmbeddingLmHead for additional memory savings.
Most effective on large-vocabulary language models.

passes.name: ShareEmbeddingLmHead
passes.description: Graph surgery to share embedding and LM-head weights, reducing model size for language models with tied embeddings.
gotchas: Only effective for models where embedding and LM-head are architecturally tied.
Pairs with QuantizeEmbeddingInt8 for maximum embedding memory savings.
No effect on models that already share weights internally.

passes.name: SimplifiedLayerNormToRMSNorm
passes.description: Graph surgery converting SimplifiedLayerNorm nodes to RMSNorm for improved QNN compatibility and performance.
gotchas: Targeted at QNN execution providers where RMSNorm has native hardware support.
SimplifiedLayerNorm and RMSNorm are mathematically equivalent when mean is zero.
May improve inference latency on Qualcomm NPUs.

passes.name: OnnxDiscrepancyCheck
passes.description: Measures numerical discrepancies on a test model to validate conversions and optimizations. This is a validation pass that does not modify the model.

test_data_dir.description: Directory containing test input/output data for discrepancy measurement.

gotchas: This pass does not modify the model — it only measures discrepancies.
Useful for validating that quantization or graph surgery preserved numerical accuracy.
